learning_outcomes.text: Develop competencies related to the structural analysis of mechanisms.
Develop competencies related to the kinematic analysis of mechanisms.
Develop competencies related to the synthesis of gear mechanisms.
Assimilate knowledge related to the development of general engineering applications.

syllabus_topics: Kinematic analysis of bar and wheel mechanisms
teaching_methods: Combined teaching using blackboard and PowerPoint with video projector
Laboratory applications related to the structure of mechanisms
Laboratory applications related to the kinematic analysis of wheel mechanisms
Laboratory applications related to the synthesis of cylindrical gears
Resolving mechanisms by students on the blackboard

assessment_methods.method: Exam with three subjects: Structure (theory + problem), Kinematics (theory + problem), Gear synthesis (theory)
Seminar activities: Solving mechanisms by students on the blackboard and short tests
Laboratory: Quiz with 5 questions and evaluation of work execution

assessment_rules: The exam is passed if the student has a passing grade in at least two out of three chapters, and the sum of the averages of the two passed chapters divided by three is at least 5.
